projection_data_date: 2026-09-03 (saved analyst-authored inputs, not a current-data refresh)
metric: sum of projections for one best legal starting lineup
benchmark_claim: Archived v2 benchmark (does not evaluate v3): across 800 simulated drafts, the saved-board policy produced 90 more projected starting-lineup points than the noisy ADP-based draft bot, on average.
availability_definition: Unconditional frequency before the draft; includes drafts where the player was taken by the simulated user. Not pass-up survival.
historical_policy: legacy; original results preserved, not rerun by this metadata script
regeneration_commands: python3 scripts/compare_policies.py --league examples/sample-league/league.yaml --players examples/sample-league/players.csv --sim examples/sample-league/sim.json --notes examples/sample-league/notes.json --drafts 800 --output examples/sample-league/benchmark.json
